Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic immunopeptidomics workflow involving the immunoaffinity purification of HLA-peptide complexes followed by LC-MS/MS. The search was performed with 'unspecific' enzyme specificity, which is standard for peptidomics.

scope: HLA-I molecules were immunoaffinity purified from cleared lysate with the pan-HLA-I antibody (W6/32 antibody purified from HB95 hybridoma cells) covalently bound to Protein-A Sepharose beads.
